'''Jedi Focus Disciplines''' were meditation techniques used to increase the damage done in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. These disciplines included [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]], [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]], [[Form V/Legends|Djem So]], [[Sokan]], [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad]]. The mastery of these will make a Jedi an offensive force beyond comparison. Even with lesser understanding of the disciplines, applying this meditative art to their use of the above forms would make for a impressive hybrid fighting form.
